content: Sofɑɑ Nɑɑmɑɡii u Yoobu wisɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: ɑ tɑmɑɑ wunɛn ɡɑri dɑbi nini kpuro nu ǹ koo wisibu wɑ?
A tɑmɑɑ tɔnu u ko n sɑ̃ɑ ɡemɡii win ɡɑri yɛ̃run sɔ̃?
Wunɛn ɡɑri sɑɑri nini nu koo de tɔmbɑ kun nun ɡɑ̃ɑnu wisɑ?
Kɑɑ yɑɑko ɡɑri ɡere ɡoo u kun nun tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃?
A ɡeruɑ ɑ nɛɛ, ye ɑ ɡeruɑ kpuro yɑ rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡem,
ɑ mɑɑ dɛɛre Gusunɔn wuswɑɑɔ.
Nɑ rɑ n kĩwɑ Gusunɔ u nɔɔ wukiɑ,
kpɑ u nun wisi.
U nun win bwisi bɛkɛn ɑsiri sɔ̃ɔsi,
kpɑ ɑ ɡiɑ mɑ u ku rɑ nun sɛɛyɑsie nɡe mɛ̀n nɔɔ wunɛn torɑnu nɛ.
A tɑmɑɑ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ Gusunɔn bwisikunu tubu?
A tɑmɑɑ kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ wi, Dɑm kpuroɡii ɡiɑ mɑm mɑm?
Win yɛ̃ru tɑ wɔllu ɡunum kere.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑ kɑɑ ko.
Tɑ mɑɑ ɡɔribun wɑ̃ɑ yeru dukum kere.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑ kɑɑ tubu mi.
Tɑ tem kpɑ̃ɑru kere,
tɑ mɑɑ nim wɔ̃ku yɑsum kere.
Gusunɔ ù n sɑrɔ,
mɑ u tɔn kɔ̃so mwɑ u kɑ dɑ siri yerɔ,
wɑrɑ u koo nùn ye yinɑri.
Domi u tɔnu kɑm yɛ̃.
U rɑ mɑɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu tubu mii mii.
Adɑmɑ tɔnu u rɑ bwisikuwɑ nɡe ɡɑri bɔkɔ,
domi bɑ nùn mɑrɑwɑ nɡe kɛtɛku ɡbeekun buu.
Yen sɔ̃, wunɛ, ɑ wunɛn ɡɔ̃ru wesio Yinni Gusunɔn mi ɡiɑ.
Kpɑ ɑ nɔmɑ yiiyɑ ɑ nùn kɑnɑ.
A kɔ̃sɑ derio,
kpɑ yɑ kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn yɛnuɔ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ kɑɑ wiru seeyɑ ɑ n dɛɛre.
Kɑɑ n tɑ̃sɑ, kpɑ ɑ kun mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnun bɛrum mɔ.
A ǹ mɑɑ wunɛn wɑhɑlɑ yeni yɑɑyɑmɔ,
yɑ koo doonɑwɑ nɡe nim mɛ mu kokɑ.
Wunɛn wɑ̃ɑrɑ koo wurɑmɑwɑ
nɡe sɔ̃ɔ wii wɔllun sɔ̃ɔ.
Kpɑ yɑm wɔ̃ku te tɑ rɑɑ nun wɑ̃ɑsi, tu ɡɔsiɑ yɑm bururɑm.
Kɑɑ n sɔ̃ kɑ toro sindu domi kɑɑ n yĩiyɔbu mɔ.
Kpuro koo nun koorɑ dee dee kpɑ ɑ wɛ̃rɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
À n kpĩ, ɡoo kun nun bɑɑsimɔ.
Tɔmbu kpuro bɑ koo wunɛn nɔnu ɡeu kɑsu.
Adɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ koo nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ.
Bɑ ǹ kuku yeru wɑsi.
Gɔɔ bɑɑsi, bɑ ǹ ko n mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu yĩiyɔ.

content: Yoobu u Sofɑɑ wisɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yinni wɔnwɔndu sɑriɡii
